subject: Proposed deployment window + on-call overlap — private VPC / air-gapped review
messages:
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@broadleafhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@broadleafhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment review — availability and constraints

Hi Vanessa / Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We are ready to lock a time for a technical architecture review focused on our private deployment constraints (VPC peering, egress restrictions, and the air-gapped staging environment). The SOW (attached) has the background and a short list of network constraints.

Two high-level asks for the call:
- Confirm feasibility of the air-gapped staging flow and data ingress/egress controls
- Validate required on-call overlap for the initial deployment window and a proposed rollback plan

We prefer the week of Aug 2–6. Our core engineering attendees are Sam Carter (me), Priya Ramesh (infra lead), and procurement on standby. Please propose 2 x 90-min slots that accommodate your internal on-call rotation.

Attachment: Broadleaf_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Sam
Sam Carter
Director, Platform Engineering
Broadleaf Health
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@broadleafhealth.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment review — availability and constraints

Sam — thanks for the SOW and clear asks. We can do a focused 90-min architecture deep-dive and bring the runtime and networking leads. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Thu Aug 5, 13:00–14:30 PDT

A couple of notes up front:
- For air-gapped staging we'll want a pre-call to review the network diagram and firewall rule scope; that can be a 30-min breakout immediately after the 90-min session if you prefer.
- On-call overlap: our standard deployment cadence requires a 2-hour overlap with your on-call for the initial 24 hours. If Broadleaf has a single on-call engineer available for the window, we can compress to 1 hour but will need documented runbooks.

Diego — can you confirm whether 10:00 PDT on Aug 3 works for the runtime/ops folks? Karthis — FYI on the on-call assumption.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- On-call contact: Priya Ramesh (Priya.Ramesh@broadleafhealth.com). Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192. Please treat this as the escalation contact for the 24-hour window.
